news.headline: Explosions rock Bolivian military barracks near La Paz
news.body: An explosion at an army barracks in Viacha on Sept 4 killed at least two people and injured dozens, officials said. Authorities said the blast originated in a defence ministry fireworks stockpile, and emergency teams warned of lingering heat and risk of further detonations while searching for missing people.
